_comment: Packages beamline-agent should discover at startup. Entries can be either a bare string (same-env import) or a dict for packages in a DIFFERENT conda env. Same-env: `import <name>` succeeds -> data_dir() mirrored, AGENTS.md copied. Cross-env dict: {"name": "pkg", "env": "conda_env_name", "path": "/abs/path/to/checkout" (optional; defaults to ~/Software/<name>), "cli": "cli-name" (optional; hint in the doc preamble)}. For cross-env entries beamline-agent CANNOT import the package, so it reads AGENTS.md from the path and prepends a note telling the agent to invoke via `conda run -n <env> <cli> ...`. Missing packages are skipped silently, so a superset list is safe.
